name: vsuee-skill
description: High-speed CLI toolkit and AI agent skill for the Visayas State University E-Learning Environment (VSUEE Moodle).
author: Vj Mabansag

scripts.test:unit: node --test test/moodle-client.test.mjs test/moodle-client-downloads.test.mjs test/session-auth.test.mjs test/sync-manager.test.mjs test/browser-runner.test.mjs
scripts.uninstall:package: npm uninstall vsuee-skill ; npm uninstall vsuee-skill
scripts.build:release:source: cp -r package.json LICENSE plugin.json AGENTS.md README.md bin lib skills .output/build/release/source
scripts.workflow:stage-release: npm run output:cleanup ; npm run output:setup ; npm run build:release:source ; npm run test:pre-npm-deployment ; npm run build:release:package
scripts.workflow:local-deploy: npm run workflow:stage-release ; npm run uninstall:package && npm run install:package:local
